summary: Cable One filed an 8-K reporting Item 2.03 and Item 8.01 disclosure that on September 17-18, 2026 it borrowed $700.0 million under its existing $1.25 billion revolving credit facility, governed by the Fourth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated February 22, 2023. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes—increasing cash on hand and preserving financial flexibility—and may be prepaid at the Company's option before the February 2028 final maturity. No board recommendation, advisor, consideration, or special-situation transaction is disclosed. Watch for follow-on use of proceeds, leverage metrics, and any future event that would convert this liquidity draw into a strategic action.
